name: Colete-Online
author: coleteonline

sections.description:
Integrate your online shop with the Colete-Online platform to validate addresses, display courier prices and create courier orders.
Colete-Online.ro offers you the ability to use all the major shipping companies available in Romania in one application, all with promotional prices and without the need for contracts. All you need is a colete-online account and you and your users can then use all the features available.

The Colete-Online platform can be used for domestic shipments in Romania or imports and/or exports that are to/from Romania.
The data is sent to our servers for validation, price calculation and order creation.

To use this plugin an account on the www.colete-online.ro platform is needed.

For further information, contact us using the contact methods listed here.

Features

  • Access to most of the delivery companies in Romania with easy access, promotional prices and no contracts needed. Only an account on our platform and you are ready to go.
  • Automatic address validation and completion that helps you avoid delivery problems that usually lead to order cancellation. If the user enters the postal code then the City, County and Street fields will be completed automatically using our database, otherwise based on the City, County and Street combination the postal code will be completed.
  • Multiple settings for displaying delivery options to your clients. You will be able to either provided a preselected delivery method based on your criteria (best price, best performance or preference) or allow the user to choose between some or all of the offers available. You can choose if you want to display a fixed custom price or if you want all the prices to be calculated base on the delivery address and on the cart contents.
  • Multiple settings for courier order activation and AWB generation. You can opt to generate the courier order automatically after the user pays the order or you can generate them later either by bulk activation or by custom advanced activation.

Colete Online website: www.colete-online.ro
Colete Online terms and conditions: www.colete-online.ro/info/general-conditions

This plugin needs woocommerce to work.
sections.installation:
After installing the plugin from the wordpress directory or using the downloaded archive you will need to enter the API credentials generated on the www.colete-online.ro platform and you are ready to use the plugin.

The configuration page where all the settings are available is on WooCommerce -> Shipping -> ColeteOnline.

A full documentation can be found on our website (www.colete-online.ro).
sections.changelog:
2.4.0

  • Address autocomplete now works on checkouts built with a theme or page builder (e.g. Woodmart / Elementor), on both the classic and the block checkout.
  • The street and number are saved together on the order address again, so they show up correctly in your other reports and integrations.
  • If your Colete Online account tops the balance up automatically from your saved card, a courier order is no longer blocked when the current balance doesn’t cover it: the balance line tells you how much will be charged to the card when the order is created, and you can continue.
  • Completed the Romanian translations for the latest settings.
  • Bug fixes and improvements.

2.3.1

  • Guest return requests (by order number and email) now reach Colete Online immediately and are confirmed only once the platform accepts them — previously the request could be silently dropped on sites where scheduled tasks (WP-Cron) are disabled. If it can’t be submitted, the customer is asked to try again instead of seeing a false confirmation.

2.3.0

  • Returns and order data now sync more reliably with your Colete Online account, so returns and shipments are matched to the right order automatically.
  • Fixed a checkout error that could stop the city and street autocomplete from loading on some sites.
  • Bug fixes and improvements.

2.2.0

  • Added returns: your customers can request a return for an eligible order from their account page (or as a guest with the order number and email), and the return form opens right on your own site.
  • Bug fixes and improvements.

2.1.0

  • Full compatibility with the WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks: couriers with live prices, locker/pickup-point selection (dropdown and interactive map), open-at-delivery, street and city autocomplete with postal-code auto-fill, and address validation now work on the block-based checkout exactly like on the classic one.
  • Redesigned the admin order shipping panel with a cleaner, full-width layout.
  • Fully responsive — the panel now works well on mobile and tablet.
  • Theme-aware styling that adapts to your WordPress admin color scheme.
  • Improved locker selection on the map and completed Romanian translations.
  • Bug fixes and improvements.

2.0.0

  • Added locker selection from an interactive map in both checkout and admin, with better support for map-based pickup point selection.
  • Moved more configuration to the colete-online.ro platform and added settings transfer logic from the plugin to the server-side account.
  • Admin order UI small restyling with improved layout, mobile-friendly responsive design and theme-aware colors.
  • Bug fixes and improvements

1.7.0

  • Locker to locker shipping integration
  • Settings for default weight, width, height and length
  • Bug fixes and improvements

1.6.0

  • Fixes for latest WooCommerce and WordPress releases.

1.5.0

  • Add fixed point (locker) from and to options
  • Allow the option to customize the checkout and add only desired fields
  • Add possibility to add tracking code in emails sent to customers

1.4.0

  • Add more control for package content autocomplete
  • Improve customer address page

1.3.1

  • Fix php short tags use case.

1.3

  • Autofocus search inputs.
  • Fix some plugin incompatibilities with other plugins.

1.2

  • Add option for optimized autocomplete search.

1.1

  • Fix some translations in Romanian.
  • Limit the number of characters for address number to 10.
  • Allow decimals in fixed price.
  • Improve street autocomplete options.

1.0

  • The initial release.
